answer: Terrace-Bound Physical Beacon Registry. Each agent identity must be anchored to a fixed physical beacon (a licensed radio or acoustic transmitter) installed at a registered site, such as a terrace or a jade warehouse, and its signal is logged by nearby infrastructure like a wharf receiver. Enforcement: one beacon signs for at most one active identity per epoch, verified by colocated receivers. Faking requires physically installing and powering a distinct beacon per identity, paying hardware, site access, and continuous power costs—so mass identities incur linear real-world cost.
